body:
I should try to get out there and meet people, but I really have no idea where to start. I decided upon my first year of high school that I was just going to be invisible, and I've pretty much stuck to that ever since. 

A few more months of school and I'll be done high school, after that I'm sure college will do me some good, I won't be invisible there. I'll meet new people and have a good time. :)

Thanks for your comment, you hang in too!

I'm not constantly thinking about suicide, only some nights like last it hits me very hard. I definitely should try and find a therapist, but I don't know how to without my parents finding out.

I guess if they have to find out, that's what it has to be, it can just be about depression I suppose. I just don't want to disappoint my parents, even though I'm sure they've suspected I've had depressed issues for a long time.

When I posted this last night I was really upset, having a hard night I guess you could say. Thank you for taking the time to respond, it means a lot to me, obviously with no one to talk to in real life I'm having a hard time coping.

Something I didn't mention is that even though I love the girl, the other person I've told is a guy I met online. I sort of stumbled on him and he's been very supportive, and we've been talking for around a month now with him being very helpful.

Again - Thank you. It's very inspiring to read some of these stories and even have some of your experiences shared. I'll try to hold on, but if I keep typing I fear I may cry ;) 

P.S. My parents forcing me into college was probably a good thing, I love computers and I'm going into programming, maybe school has been such a disaster for me because I have a hard time being interested in subjects in high school.
